en.title: Nvidia board rejects Jensen Huang return while petition for reinstatement grows
en.dek: Over 180,200 people signed a petition demanding Jensen Huang return as Nvidia CEO, but the company's board remains focused on an internal probe.
facts: A petition demanding Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO reached over 180,200 signatures, according to The Japan Times.
Nvidia's board of directors is not considering reinstating Huang as chief executive officer, a source told CNBC.
Accounts linked to Donald Trump traded up to $97.5 million in Nvidia stock, according to CNBC.
Trump sold up to $1 million in Nvidia stock five days after receiving a briefing about Huang's relationship with a suspected Chinese spy, CNBC reported.
U.S. President Donald Trump stated he would not mind if Huang returned to Nvidia, according to The Guardian and The Hindu.
body: A online petition demanding the reinstatement of former Nvidia chief executive officer Jensen Huang gathered over 180,200 signatures, according to reporting by The Japan Times. Despite the growing public support, Nvidia's board of directors is not currently considering Huang's return to the company, according to The Hill.

Nvidia's board remains focused on an internal investigation into Huang following his resignation, a source told CNBC. Board members are not holding discussions about bringing Huang back as CEO, according to reporting by The Verge.

Financial disclosures show that accounts associated with U.S. President Donald Trump traded up to $97.5 million in Nvidia stock, CNBC reported. President Trump sold up to $1 million in Nvidia shares five days after receiving an official briefing regarding Huang's relationship with a suspected Chinese spy, according to the same outlet.

U.S. President Donald Trump told reporters that he would not mind if Huang returned as CEO, stating that Huang had learned a big lesson. President Trump also cited a big group of people who want Huang back, according to reports from The Guardian and The Hindu. He added that the scandal did not put U.S. national security at risk, according to CNBC and The Washington Post.

Tech executives and investors have launched public efforts lobbying for Huang's return following his resignation. Elon Musk joined an open letter demanding that Nvidia reinstate Huang, according to Euronews and ZDF heute. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman called Huang a hero who has flaws during an appearance at a Semafor event, according to Semafor and MIT Technology Review.

Huang's resignation followed reports linking him to an alleged romantic relationship with an individual suspected of espionage, according to G1 and Axios. Conservative political figures have used the scandal to attempt to influence President Trump's relationship with the technology sector, Axios reported.

Singapore-based firm Megaspeed announced that Alice Huang left the company in August 2025, according to the New York Times and Al Jazeera. U.S. officials allege that Alice Huang conducted espionage activities on behalf of China, both outlets reported.

Nvidia's stock price continued to drop as market investors calculated the potential commercial fallout from Huang's departure, according to CNBC and MarketWatch. The price decline coincided with a wider market sell-off across artificial intelligence stocks, according to reporting by The Guardian.
en.context: Nvidia designs graphics processing units used extensively to train and run artificial intelligence models. Former CEO Jensen Huang resigned after reports linked him to an individual accused by U.S. officials of spying for China.

de.title: Nvidia-Vorstand lehnt Rückkehr von Jensen Huang ab, Petition für Wiederaufnahme wächst
de.dek: Über 180.200 Menschen unterzeichneten eine Petition, die die Rückkehr von Jensen Huang als CEO von Nvidia fordert, doch der Vorstand des Unternehmens konzentriert sich auf eine interne Untersuchung.
facts: Eine Petition, die die Rückkehr von Jensen Huang als CEO von Nvidia fordert, erreichte laut The Japan Times über 180.200 Unterschriften
Der Vorstand von Nvidia erwägt nicht, Huang als Vorstandsvorsitzenden wieder einzustellen, so eine Quelle gegenüber CNBC
Konten, die mit Donald Trump verbunden sind, handelten bis zu 97,5 Millionen US-Dollar Nvidia-Aktien, wie CNBC berichtete
Trump verkaufte fünf Tage nach Erhalt eines Briefings über Huangs Beziehung zu einem mutmaßlichen chinesischen Spion bis zu 1 Million US-Dollar Nvidia-Aktien, berichtete CNBC
US-Präsident Donald Trump erklärte, er wäre nicht dagegen, wenn Huang zu Nvidia zurückkehren würde, so The Guardian und The Hindu
body: Eine Online-Petition, die die Wiedereinsetzung des ehemaligen Nvidia-Geschäftsführers Jensen Huang fordert, sammelte laut Berichten der Japan Times über 180.200 Unterschriften.
Trotz der wachsenden öffentlichen Unterstützung erwägt der Nvidia-Vorstand derzeit nicht die Rückkehr Huangs in das Unternehmen, so The Hill.
Eine Quelle teilte CNBC mit, dass sich der Nvidia-Vorstand weiterhin auf eine interne Untersuchung von Huang nach seinem Rücktritt konzentriert.
Vorstandsmitglieder führen laut Berichten von The Verge keine Diskussionen über die Rückkehr Huangs als CEO.
Finanzangaben zeigen, dass Konten, die mit US-Präsident Donald Trump verbunden sind, bis zu 97,5 Millionen US-Dollar in Nvidia-Aktien gehandelt haben, berichtete CNBC.

Präsident Trump verkaufte fünf Tage nach Erhalt eines offiziellen Briefings über Huangs Beziehung zu einem mutmaßlichen chinesischen Spion bis zu 1 Million US-Dollar an Nvidia-Aktien, so derselbe Sender.

US-Präsident Donald Trump sagte Reportern, er wäre nicht dagegen, wenn Huang als CEO zurückkehren würde, da Huang eine wichtige Lektion gelernt habe, und zitierte laut Berichten von The Guardian und The Hindu eine große Gruppe von Menschen, die Huang zurückwollen.

Er fügte hinzu, dass der Skandal die nationale Sicherheit der USA nicht gefährdet habe, so CNBC und The Washington Post, während Tech-Führungskräfte und Investoren nach seinem Rücktritt öffentliche Bemühungen für seine Rückkehr unternommen haben, darunter Elon Musk, der in einem offenen Brief die Wiedereinsetzung Huangs forderte, laut Euronews und ZDF heute.
de.context: Nvidia entwickelt Grafikprozessoreinheiten, die intensiv zum Trainieren und Betreiben von künstlicher Intelligenz eingesetzt werden. Der ehemalige CEO Jensen Huang trat zurück, nachdem Berichte ihn mit einer Person in Verbindung brachten, die von US-Beamten beschuldigt wurde, für China gespioniert zu haben.

fr.title: Le conseil d'administration de Nvidia rejette le retour de Jensen Huang tandis qu'une pétition pour sa réintégration grandit
fr.dek: Plus de 180 200 personnes ont signé une pétition exigeant le retour de Jensen Huang en tant que PDG de Nvidia, mais le conseil d'administration de l'entreprise se concentre sur une enquête interne.
facts: Une pétition exigeant le retour de Jensen Huang en tant que PDG de Nvidia a recueilli plus de 180 200 signatures, selon The Japan Times
Le conseil d'administration de Nvidia n'envisage pas de réintégrer Huang en tant que directeur général, a indiqué une source à CNBC
Des comptes liés à Donald Trump ont négocié jusqu'à 97,5 millions de dollars d'actions Nvidia, selon CNBC
Trump a vendu jusqu'à 1 million de dollars d'actions Nvidia cinq jours après avoir reçu un briefing sur la relation de Huang avec un espion chinois présumé, a rapporté CNBC
Le président américain Donald Trump a déclaré qu'il ne s'opposerait pas au retour de Huang chez Nvidia, selon The Guardian et The Hindu
body: Une pétition en ligne exigeant le retour de l'ancien PDG de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, a recueilli plus de 180 200 signatures, selon le reporting du Japan Times.
Malgré le soutien public croissant, le conseil d'administration de Nvidia n'envisage pas actuellement le retour de Huang dans l'entreprise, selon The Hill.
Un proche de CNBC a indiqué que le conseil de Nvidia se concentre sur une enquête interne concernant Huang suite à sa démission.
Les membres du conseil ne discutent pas du retour de Huang en tant que PDG, selon le reporting de The Verge.
Des déclarations financières montrent que des comptes associés au président américain Donald Trump ont négocié jusqu'à 97,5 millions de dollars d'actions Nvidia, a rapporté CNBC.

Le président Trump a vendu jusqu'à 1 million de dollars d'actions Nvidia cinq jours après avoir reçu un briefing officiel sur la relation de Huang avec un suspect d'espionnage chinois, selon la même source.
Le président américain Donald Trump a déclaré aux journalistes qu'il ne s'opposerait pas au retour de Huang en tant que PDG, affirmant que Huang avait tiré une leçon importante.

Le président Trump a également cité un grand nombre de personnes souhaitant le retour de Huang, selon The Guardian et The Hindu, ajoutant que le scandale ne mettait pas en danger la sécurité nationale américaine, selon CNBC et The Washington Post.
fr.context: Nvidia conçoit des unités de traitement graphique utilisées intensivement pour entraîner et exécuter des modèles d'intelligence artificielle. L'ancien PDG Jensen Huang a démissionné après des rapports le reliant à un individu accusé par des responsables américains d'espionnage pour la Chine.

es.title: El consejo de Nvidia rechaza el regreso de Jensen Huang mientras crece la petición de reinstauración
es.dek: Más de 180.200 personas firmaron una petición exigiendo el regreso de Jensen Huang como CEO de Nvidia, pero el consejo de la empresa se mantiene centrado en una investigación interna.
facts: Una petición que exige el regreso de Jensen Huang como CEO de Nvidia superó las 180.200 firmas, según The Japan Times
El consejo de administración de Nvidia no está considerando reinstaurar a Huang como director ejecutivo, según una fuente a CNBC
Cuentas vinculadas a Donald Trump negociaron hasta 97,5 millones de dólares en acciones de Nvidia, según CNBC
Trump vendió hasta 1 millón de dólares en acciones de Nvidia cinco días después de recibir un informe sobre la relación de Huang con un presunto espía chino, informó CNBC
El presidente estadounidense Donald Trump declaró que no le importaría si Huang regresaba a Nvidia, según The Guardian y The Hindu
body: Una petición en línea que exige la reinstauración del exdirector ejecutivo de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, ha reunido más de 180.200 firmas, según informó The Japan Times.
A pesar del creciente apoyo público, la junta directiva de Nvidia no está considerando actualmente el regreso de Huang a la compañía, según The Hill.
Una fuente dijo a CNBC que la junta de Nvidia se mantiene centrada en una investigación interna sobre Huang tras su dimisión.
Los miembros de la junta no están manteniendo discusiones sobre la vuelta de Huang como director ejecutivo, según reporta The Verge.
Revelaciones financieras indican que cuentas asociadas al presidente estadounidense Donald Trump negociaron hasta 97,5 millones de dólares en acciones de Nvidia, informó CNBC.
El presidente Trump vendió hasta 1 millón de acciones de Nvidia cinco días después de recibir un informe oficial sobre la relación de Huang con un presunto espía chino, según la misma fuente.
El presidente estadounidense Donald Trump declaró a los periodistas que no le importaría si Huang regresaba como director ejecutivo, afirmando que Huang había aprendido una gran lección.

Trump también citó a un gran grupo de personas que desean el regreso de Huang, según informes de The Guardian y The Hindu, y añadió que el escándalo no puso en riesgo la seguridad nacional de EE. UU., según CNBC y The Washington Post.
es.context: Nvidia diseña unidades de procesamiento gráfico utilizadas ampliamente para entrenar y ejecutar modelos de inteligencia artificial. El exdirector ejecutivo Jensen Huang dimitió tras informes que lo vincularon a un individuo acusado por funcionarios estadounidenses de espionaje para China.

it.title: Il consiglio di Nvidia respinge il ritorno di Jensen Huang mentre cresce la petizione per il suo reintegro
it.dek: Oltre 180.200 persone hanno firmato una petizione che chiede il ritorno di Jensen Huang come CEO di Nvidia, ma il consiglio di amministrazione dell'azienda si concentra su un'indagine interna.
facts: Una petizione che chiede il ritorno di Jensen Huang come CEO di Nvidia ha raccolto oltre 180.200 firme, secondo The Japan Times
Il consiglio di amministrazione di Nvidia non sta valutando il reintegro di Huang come amministratore delegato, ha riferito una fonte a CNBC
Conti collegati a Donald Trump hanno scambiato fino a 97,5 milioni di dollari di azioni Nvidia, secondo CNBC
Trump ha venduto fino a 1 milione di dollari di azioni Nvidia cinque giorni dopo aver ricevuto un briefing sulla relazione di Huang con un presunto spia cinese, ha riportato CNBC
Il presidente statunitense Donald Trump ha dichiarato che non le dispiacerebbe se Huang tornasse in Nvidia, secondo The Guardian e The Hindu
body: Una petizione online che chiedeva il rientro del precedente amministratore delegato di Nvidia, Jensen Huang, ha raccolto oltre 180.200 firme, secondo quanto riportato dal The Japan Times.
Nonostante il crescente sostegno pubblico, il consiglio di amministrazione di Nvidia non sta attualmente valutando il ritorno di Huang in azienda, secondo The Hill.
Una fonte ha dichiarato a CNBC che il consiglio di amministrazione di Nvidia è concentrato su un'indagine interna su Huang a seguito della sua dimissione.
I membri del consiglio non stanno discutendo il rientro di Huang come CEO, secondo quanto riportato da The Verge.
Le dichiarazioni finanziarie mostrano che conti associati al presidente statunitense Donald Trump hanno acquistato fino a 97,5 milioni di dollari di azioni Nvidia, ha riferito CNBC.

Il presidente Trump ha venduto fino a 1 milione di dollari di azioni Nvidia cinque giorni dopo aver ricevuto un briefing ufficiale sulla relazione di Huang con un presunto spia cinese, secondo la stessa testata.
Il presidente statunitense Donald Trump ha dichiarato ai giornalisti che non avrebbe problemi se Huang fosse tornato come CEO, affermando che Huang aveva imparato una grande lezione.

Trump ha anche citato un vasto gruppo di persone che desiderano il ritorno di Huang, secondo rapporti del The Guardian e The Hindu, aggiungendo che lo scandalo non ha messo a rischio la sicurezza nazionale statunitense, secondo CNBC e The Washington Post.
it.context: Nvidia progetta unità di elaborazione grafica utilizzate ampiamente per addestrare ed eseguire modelli di intelligenza artificiale. L'ex CEO Jensen Huang si era dimesso dopo che rapporti lo avevano collegato a un individuo accusato dalle autorità statunitensi di spionaggio per la Cina.

pt.title: Conselho da Nvidia rejeita o regresso de Jensen Huang enquanto cresce petição de reintegração
pt.dek: Mais de 180.200 pessoas assinaram uma petição exigindo o regresso de Jensen Huang como CEO da Nvidia, mas o conselho da empresa mantém o foco numa investigação interna.
facts: Uma petição exigindo o regresso de Jensen Huang como CEO da Nvidia atingiu mais de 180.200 assinaturas, segundo The Japan Times
O conselho de administração da Nvidia não está a considerar a reintegração de Huang como diretor executivo, informou uma fonte à CNBC
Contas ligadas a Donald Trump negociaram até 97,5 milhões de dólares em ações da Nvidia, segundo a CNBC
Trump vendeu até 1 milhão de dólares em ações da Nvidia cinco dias após receber um briefing sobre a relação de Huang com um suspeito espião chinês, reportou a CNBC
O Presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, declarou que não se importaria se Huang regressasse à Nvidia, segundo The Guardian e The Hindu
body: Uma petição online que exige a reintegração do ex-executivo da Nvidia, Jensen Huang, recolheu mais de 180.200 assinaturas, segundo reportagem do The Japan Times.
Apesar do crescente apoio público, o conselho de administração da Nvidia não está atualmente a considerar o regresso de Huang à empresa, de acordo com The Hill.
Uma fonte informou à CNBC que o conselho da Nvidia mantém o foco numa investigação interna sobre Huang após a sua demissão.
Os membros do conselho não estão a discutir o regresso de Huang como CEO, segundo reportagem do The Verge.
Divulgações financeiras mostram que contas associadas ao Presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, negociaram até 97,5 milhões de dólares em ações da Nvidia, reportou a CNBC.
O Presidente Trump vendeu até 1 milhão de dólares em ações da Nvidia cinco dias após receber um briefing oficial sobre a relação de Huang com um suspeito espião chinês, segundo a mesma fonte.
O Presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, disse a repórteres que não se importaria se Huang regressasse como CEO, afirmando que Huang tinha aprendido uma grande lição.

O Presidente Trump também citou um grande grupo de pessoas que querem o regresso de Huang, segundo relatórios do The Guardian e do The Hindu, acrescentando que o escândalo não colocou em risco a segurança nacional dos EUA, segundo a CNBC e The Washington Post.
pt.context: A Nvidia projeta unidades de processamento gráfico usadas extensivamente no treino e execução de modelos de inteligência artificial. O ex-CEO Jensen Huang renunciou após reportagens o ligarem a um indivíduo acusado por autoridades dos EUA de espionagem para a China.

zh.title: 英伟达董事会拒绝黄仁勋回归 恢复任职请愿书持续增长
zh.dek: 超过180,200人签署请愿书要求黄仁勋重返英伟达CEO职位 但公司董事会仍专注于内部调查
facts: 据《日本时报》报道，要求黄仁勋重返英伟达CEO职位的请愿书已获超过180,200个签名
据一位消息人士告诉CNBC，英伟达董事会不考虑恢复黄仁勋的首席执行官职务
据CNBC报道，与唐纳德·特朗普相关的账户在英伟达股票上交易额高达9750万美元
CNBC报道，特朗普在获悉黄仁勋与一名涉嫌中国间谍的个人有关联的简报五天后，出售了价值高达100万美元的英伟达股票
据《卫报》和《印度时报》报道，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示他不介意黄仁勋重返英伟达
body: 据《日本时报》报道，一份要求英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋复职的在线请愿书已收集到超过180,200个签名。
尽管公众支持日益增长，但据《希尔报》报道，英伟达董事会目前不考虑黄仁勋重返公司。
一位消息人士告诉CNBC，英伟达董事会仍专注于对黄仁勋辞职后的内部调查。
据《可汗》报道，董事会成员没有就聘请黄仁勋担任首席执行官进行讨论。
CNBC报道，财务披露显示，与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普相关的账户曾买入高达9750万美元的英伟达股票。
同媒体报道，在获悉黄仁勋与一名涉嫌中国间谍的个人关系情况的官方简报五天后，特朗普总统出售了高达100万美元的英伟达股票。
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普告诉记者，他不介意黄仁勋重返首席执行官职位，并表示黄仁勋吸取了重大教训。
特朗普总统还援引了要求黄仁勋回归的众多民众，据《卫报》和《印度时报》报道，他补充说，该丑闻并未危及美国国家安全，据CNBC和《华盛顿邮报》报道。
zh.context: 英伟达设计用于训练和运行人工智能模型的图形处理器 前CEO黄仁勋在有报道称他与一名被美国官员指控为为中国间谍的个人有关联后辞职

ja.title: Nvidia取締役会はジェンセン・フアンの復帰を拒否、復帰を求める請願は増加
ja.dek: 180,200人以上がジェンセン・フアンのNvidia CEO復帰を求める請願に署名したが、同社取締役会は社内調査に注力している
facts: 日本経済新聞によると、ジェンセン・フアンのNvidia CEO復帰を求める請願は180,200以上の署名を集めた
情報筋によると、Nvidiaの取締役会はフアンの最高経営責任者としての復帰を検討していない
CNBCによると、ドナルド・トランプ氏に関連する口座はNvidia株で最大9,750万ドルを取引した
CNBCの報道によると、トランプ氏はフアンと中国のスパイ容疑者との関係に関するブリーフィングを受けた5日後にNvidia株で最大100万ドルを売却した
ガーディアン紙とヒンドゥー紙によると、ドナルド・トランプ米大統領はフアンがNvidiaに復帰しても構わないと述べた
body: 日本・タイムズの報道によると、元Nvidia最高経営責任者ジェンセン・フアンの復帰を求めるオンライン請願は180,200以上の署名を集めました。
しかし、ヒル紙によれば、世論の支持が高まっているにもかかわらず、Nvidiaの取締役会は現在、フアンの会社復帰を検討していません。
ある情報筋はCNBCに対し、Nvidiaの取締役会はフアンの辞任後、内部調査に注力していると語りました。
また、ヴァージの報道によれば、取締役会メンバーはフアンをCEOとして復帰させることについての議論は行っていません。
CNBCが報じた金融開示によると、ドナルド・トランプ米大統領に関連する口座は、Nvidia株で最大9,750万ドルを取引していました。
同メディアによると、トランプ大統領は、フアンが中国のスパイ容疑者との関係について公式ブリーフィングを受けた5日後に、Nvidia株を最大100万ドル分売却しました。
ドナルド・トランプ米大統領は記者団に対し、フアンが大きな教訓を学んだと述べ、CEOとして復帰しても構わないと語りました。
トランプ大統領はまた、ガーディアン紙やヒンドゥー紙の報道に基づき、フアンの復帰を望む多くの人々がいること、そしてスキャンダルが米国の国家安全保障を脅かすものではないとCNBCやワシントン・ポスト紙で付け加えました。
ja.context: Nvidiaは、人工知能モデルの訓練と実行に広範に使用されるグラフィックス処理ユニットを設計している。元CEOのジェンセン・フアンは、米国当局が中国へのスパイ行為で告発した人物との関連が報じられた後、辞任した。

ko.title: 엔비디아 이사회, 젠슨 황 복귀 거부... 복귀 청원서 증가세
ko.dek: 180,200명 이상이 젠슨 황의 엔비디아 CEO 복귀를 요구하는 청원에 서명했으나, 회사 이사회는 내부 조사에 집중하고 있다.
facts: 일본타임스에 따르면 젠슨 황의 엔비디아 CEO 복귀를 요구하는 청원에 180,200명 이상이 서명했다
한 소식통은 CNBC에 엔비디아 이사회가 황의 최고경영자 복귀를 고려하고 있지 않다고 밝혔다
CNBC에 따르면 도널드 트럼프와 연관된 계좌가 엔비디아 주식에서 최대 9,750만 달러를 거래했다
CNBC 보도에 따르면 트럼프는 황이 의심되는 중국 스파이와의 관계에 대한 브리핑을 받은 5일 후 엔비디아 주식 최대 100만 달러를 매도했다
가디언과 힌두에 따르면 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 황이 엔비디아로 복귀하는 것에 개의치 않을 것이라고 밝혔다
body: 일본 타임스 보도에 따르면, 전 엔비디아 최고경영자 젠슨 황의 복귀를 요구하는 온라인 청원서에 180,200명 이상이 서명했습니다.
하지만 더 힐에 따르면, 대중적 지지가 커지고 있음에도 불구하고 엔비디아 이사회는 현재 황의 회사 복귀를 고려하고 있지 않습니다.
한 소식통은 CNBC에 엔비디아 이사회가 황의 사임 이후 내부 조사를 진행하는 데 집중하고 있다고 전했습니다.
더 버지 보도에 따르면, 이사회 구성원들은 황을 CEO로 복귀시키는 것에 대한 논의를 진행하고 있지 않습니다.
CNBC는 금융 공시 자료에 따르면 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 관련된 계좌가 엔비디아 주식 최대 9,750만 달러를 거래한 것으로 나타났다고 보도했습니다.
같은 매체에 따르면, 트럼프 대통령은 황이 중국 스파이 의혹자와의 관계에 대해 공식 브리핑을 받은 5일 후 엔비디아 주식 최대 100만 달러를 매도했습니다.
도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 기자들에게 황이 큰 교훈을 얻었다며 CEO로 복귀하는 것에 개의치 않겠다고 말했습니다.
트럼프 대통령은 또한 가디언과 힌두 신문 보도에 따라 황의 복귀를 원하는 많은 사람들이 있다고 언급했으며, CNBC와 워싱턴 포스트에 따르면 이 스캔들이 미국 국가 안보를 위협하지는 않았다고 덧붙였습니다.
ko.context: 엔비디아는 인공지능 모델 훈련 및 실행에 광범위하게 사용되는 그래픽 처리 장치를 설계한다. 전 CEO 젠슨 황은 미국 관리들이 중국을 위해 스파이 행위를 했다고 비난한 개인과 연루되었다는 보도 이후 사임했다.

en.title: Nvidia board rejects Jensen Huang return while Donald Trump supports reinstatement
en.dek: Nvidia's board is focusing on an internal probe rather than reinstating former CEO Jensen Huang, despite support from Donald Trump and tech executives.
facts: Nvidia's board is not considering reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO, according to CNBC and The Verge.
U.S. President Donald Trump stated he would not mind if Huang returned as CEO, according to The Guardian and The Hindu.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman publicly expressed support for Huang at a Semafor event, according to Semafor and MIT Technology Review.
Elon Musk joined an open letter that reached 165,000 signatures demanding Huang's return, according to Euronews and CNBC.
Megaspeed confirmed Alice Huang left the company in August 2025, according to the New York Times and Al Jazeera.
body: Nvidia's board of directors is not considering hiring Jensen Huang back as chief executive officer, a source told CNBC. The board is currently focused on an internal investigation into Huang following his resignation and is not holding discussions about his reinstatement, according to The Verge.

U.S. President Donald Trump said he would not mind if Huang returned as Nvidia CEO, stating that Huang had learned a big lesson. President Trump added that a big group of people wanted Huang's return, according to reports from The Guardian and The Hindu. President Trump also told reporters the affair did not put U.S. national security at risk, according to CNBC and The Washington Post.

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman called Huang a hero who has flaws during an appearance at a Semafor event, according to Semafor and MIT Technology Review. Altman acknowledged Huang's central role in artificial intelligence development while addressing the ongoing controversy.

Tech executives and investors have built a public campaign to lobby for Huang's reinstatement following his resignation. Elon Musk joined an open petition demanding that Nvidia bring back Huang, according to Euronews and ZDF heute. The petition reached 165,000 signatures, according to reporting by The Guardian and CNBC.

Huang's resignation followed reports linking him to an alleged romantic relationship with an individual suspected of espionage, according to G1 and Axios. Conservative political figures have used the scandal to attempt to influence President Trump's relationship with the technology sector, Axios reported.

Singapore-based firm Megaspeed stated on 16 November that Alice Huang left the company in August 2025, according to the New York Times and Al Jazeera. U.S. officials allege that Alice Huang conducted espionage activities on behalf of China, both outlets reported.

Nvidia's stock price continued to slide as investors calculated the potential market fallout from Huang's departure, according to CNBC and MarketWatch. The ongoing developments coincided with a broader market sell-off across artificial intelligence stocks, according to The Guardian.
en.context: Nvidia designs graphics processing units used extensively in artificial intelligence models. Former CEO Jensen Huang resigned after reports linked him to an individual accused by U.S. officials of spying for China.

body: Elon Musk has joined a public campaign to reinstate Jensen Huang as the CEO of Nvidia, according to Euronews and ZDF heute. The petition has gathered 165,000 signatures from shareholders and technology industry figures, as reported by The Guardian and CNBC.

Jensen Huang is currently involved in a scandal regarding an alleged romantic relationship with Alice Huang, who U.S. officials claim is a Chinese spy, according to G1 and Axios. Jensen Huang resigned from his position as Nvidia CEO prior to the emergence of these allegations and the subsequent public campaign for his return. Supporters of his reinstatement include various figures within the technology industry, according to CNBC.

facts: Elon Musk hat sich einer Petition angeschlossen, die die Wiedereinsetzung von Jensen Huang als CEO von Nvidia fordert.
Ein offener Brief, der die Rückkehr von Huang fordert, hat 165.000 Unterschriften erreicht.

body: Elon Musk hat sich laut Euronews und ZDF heute einer öffentlichen Kampagne zur Wiedereinsetzung von Jensen Huang als CEO von Nvidia angeschlossen. Die Petition hat 165.000 Unterschriften von Aktionären und Persönlichkeiten der Technologiebranche gesammelt, wie The Guardian und CNBC berichteten.

Jensen Huang ist derzeit in einen Skandal um eine mutmaßliche Liebesbeziehung mit Alice Huang verwickelt, die laut US-Behörden eine chinesische Spionin sein soll, wie G1 und Axios meldeten. Diese Vorwürfe haben konservative politische Akteure dazu veranlasst, zu versuchen, das Verhältnis von Präsident Trump zum Technologiesektor zu beeinflussen, berichtete Axios.

Megaspeed erklärte am 16. November, dass Alice Huang das in Singapur ansässige Unternehmen im August 2025 verlassen habe. Das Unternehmen bestätigte ihr Austrittsdatum nach Berichten, die sie mit dem ehemaligen Nvidia-Manager in Verbindung brachten.

US-Behörden werfen Alice Huang Spionageaktivitäten im Auftrag Chinas vor, wie die New York Times und Al Jazeera berichteten. Diese Anschuldigungen stehen im Zusammenhang mit laufenden nationalen Sicherheitsuntersuchungen, so beide Medien.

Jensen Huang trat von seinem Posten als Nvidia-CEO zurück, bevor diese Vorwürfe und die darauffolgende öffentliche Kampagne für seine Rückkehr aufkamen. Zu den Unterstützern seiner Wiedereinsetzung zählen laut CNBC verschiedene Persönlichkeiten der Technologiebranche.

Aktien aus dem Bereich der künstlichen Intelligenz haben angesichts dieser Entwicklungen einen Marktausverkauf erlebt. The Guardian berichtete, dass die Volatilität mit den laufenden Führungsdiskussionen bei Nvidia zusammenhängt.
de.context: Nvidia ist ein bedeutender Hersteller von Grafikprozessoren, die bei der Entwicklung künstlicher Intelligenz eingesetzt werden. Das Unternehmen sieht sich nach Vorwürfen der Wirtschaftsspionage, in die Personen aus dem Umfeld der ehemaligen Führungsebene verwickelt sind, mit einer genauen Prüfung konfrontiert.
